name: Sildenafil
description: Small-molecule PDE5 inhibitor taken by mouth; active ingredient in Viagra and Revatio

note.text: No published human study tested sildenafil as a gum, gummy or troche, or with oxytocin. Vybrique is the approved oral film.

bullets: **Blocks PDE5,** the enzyme that breaks down cGMP, per the label
**Nitric oxide** released during sexual stimulation raises cGMP
**No effect without** sexual stimulation, per the label
Approved for ED in 1998, for PAH in 2005

notEstablished.text: Use after a recent heart attack

practical.pharmacokinetics: Peak in 30 to 120 minutes (median 60); liver (CYP3A4, CYP2C9)
practical.soldAs: Prescription tablets and film (Viagra, Revatio, Vybrique)
practical.monitored: Blood pressure, vision and hearing changes, erections over 4 hours

references: Goldstein et al., N Engl J Med, oral sildenafil for ED, May 1998
